Figure 14: Determination of Scheme layer D
As shown in Table 6, the comprehensive benefits of an agro-ecosystem can be taken as
the target layer, which can be evaluated through four standard layers. These four aspects can in
turn be reflected through a number of indicators.
Supplementary note to C4: The C4 indicator is a subjective scoring indicator. We
mainly consider money costs, time costs and labor costs. For example, manual weed-
ing significantly increases labor and time costs, and fertilizer application takes time
from implementation to effect, so time costs increase.
